# Data samples: world-development

Every data type of `world-development` as a real record of the committed test data, every field explained from its data contract, the fields only other rows have and a checklist for the production query. The [index](README.md) lists every domain.

- [development-profile](#development-profile)
- [development-series](#development-series)

<a id="development-profile"></a>

## Development profile: development-profile (WDI)

One country's World Development Indicators: the latest of each, the world map shaded by GDP per head, each series one click away. One row per development profile, keyed by PROFILE_ID. Read by the **world-development** pack's connector `development-store` (table `<root>/development/development-profile/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/economy/world-development/samples/development-profile.jsonl`, 12 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/economy/world-development/samples/development-profile.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `PROFILE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `ISO3`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `REGION`, `INCOME_GROUP`, `POPULATION`, `GDP_PER_CAPITA`, `GDP_GROWTH`, `INFLATION`, `UNEMPLOYMENT`, `LIFE_EXPECTANCY` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 12 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "CAPITAL": "Canberra",
  "CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT_DEBT": 57.8834285733848,
  "COUNTRY_NAME": "Australia",
  "DATA_YEAR": "2025",
  "ELECTRICITY_ACCESS": 100.0,
  "GDP_GROWTH": 1.35039785076631,
  "GDP_PER_CAPITA": 65129.7227990563,
  "INCOME_GROUP": "High income",
  "INDICATORS": [
    {
      "CODE": "SP.POP.TOTL",
      "INDICATOR": "Population, total",
      "LATEST": 27614411.0,
      "UNIT": "persons",
      "WDI_SERIES": "WDIS-AUS-SP_POP_TOTL",
      "YEAR": "2025"
    },
    {
      "CODE": "NY.GDP.PCAP.CD",
      "INDICATOR": "GDP per capita (current US$)",
      "LATEST": 65129.7227990563,
      "UNIT": "current USD",
      "WDI_SERIES": "WDIS-AUS-NY_GDP_PCAP_CD",
      "YEAR": "2025"
    },
    "… 8 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "INDICATOR_COUNT": 10,
  "INFLATION": 2.87403791660173,
  "INTERNET_USERS": 96.13140106,
  "ISO2": "AU",
  "ISO3": "AUS",
  "LIFE_EXPECTANCY": 83.0512195121951,
  "NAME": "Australia",
  "POPULATION": 27614411.0,
  "POVERTY_HEADCOUNT": 0.9,
  "PROFILE_ID": "WDI-AUS",
  "PROVENANCE": {
    "ATTRIBUTION": "The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0).",
    "DATASET": "World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)",
    "INTERNAL_ONLY": false,
    "LICENCE": "CC BY 4.0",
    "RETRIEVED_AT": "2026-11-06",
    "SOURCE": "World Bank, World Development Indicators",
    "URL": "https://data.worldbank.org/country/AU"
  },
  "REGION": "East Asia & Pacific",
  "UNEMPLOYMENT": 4.09
}
```

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CAPITAL` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The capital city as the World Bank lists it. | — | `"Canberra"` |
| `CENTRAL_GOVERNMENT_DEBT` | number | optional (filled in 58% of rows) | Central government debt, total (GC.DOD.TOTL.GD.ZS), the latest year; empty for most economies that do not report it. | unit: % of GDP | `57.8834285733848` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. | — | `"Australia"` |
| `DATA_YEAR` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The most recent year any indicator of the economy has a value for. | — | `"2025"` |
| `ELECTRICITY_ACCESS` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Share of the population with access to electricity (EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS), the latest year. | unit: % of population | `100.0` |
| `GDP_GROWTH` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Annual growth of GDP at constant prices (NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG), the latest year. | unit: % a year | `1.35039785076631` |
| `GDP_PER_CAPITA` | number | optional (filled in every row) | GDP divided by mid-year population, current US dollars (NY.GDP.PCAP.CD), the latest year. | unit: USD | `65129.7227990563` |
| `INCOME_GROUP` | string | required | The World Bank income group by GNI per head (Low, Lower middle, Upper middle, High income). | links to `country-group` | `"High income"` |
| `INDICATORS` | array of objects | required | Every indicator the feed pulled for the economy, one row each: INDICATOR, UNIT, LATEST, YEAR, CODE and WDI_SERIES. | links to `macro-indicator` | [10 objects] |
| `INDICATORS[].CODE` | string | required | The indicator's code in the World Bank API (SP.POP.TOTL). | — | `"SP.POP.TOTL"` |
| `INDICATORS[].INDICATOR` | string | required | The indicator's name as the World Bank publishes it. | — | `"Population, total"` |
| `INDICATORS[].LATEST` | number | required | The latest published value, in the unit shown. | unit: the row's UNIT | `27614411.0` |
| `INDICATORS[].UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures (the feed's YAML names it). | seen: `% of population`, `% a year`, `% of labour force`, `current USD`, `persons`, `years`, `% of GDP` | `"persons"` |
| `INDICATORS[].WDI_SERIES` | string | required | The development-series page with the history (WDIS-<ISO3>-<code>). | pattern `^WDIS-`; links to `development-series` | `"WDIS-AUS-SP_POP_TOTL"` |
| `INDICATORS[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the latest value. | seen: `2025`, `2024`, `2022`, `2020`, `2021`, `2023` | `"2025"` |
| `INDICATOR_COUNT` | integer | required | How many indicators have at least one value for the economy. | seen: `10`, `9` | `10` |
| `INFLATION` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Consumer price inflation (FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG), the latest year. | unit: % a year | `2.87403791660173` |
| `INTERNET_USERS` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Share of the population using the internet (IT.NET.USER.ZS), the latest year. | unit: % of population | `96.13140106` |
| `ISO2` | string | required | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (the World Bank's own id). | — | `"AU"` |
| `ISO3` | string | required | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, the key the map shades by. | — | `"AUS"` |
| `LIFE_EXPECTANCY` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Life expectancy at birth (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), the latest year. | unit: years | `83.0512195121951` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. | — | `"Australia"` |
| `POPULATION` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Total population, mid-year (SP.POP.TOTL), the latest year with a value. | unit: persons | `27614411.0` |
| `POVERTY_HEADCOUNT` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Share living below the World Bank's international poverty line (SI.POV.DDAY), the latest survey year. | unit: % of population | `0.9` |
| `PROFILE_ID` | string | required | WDI- and the country's ISO 3166 alpha-3 code. | pattern `^WDI-` | `"WDI-AUS"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | — | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"CC BY 4.0"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The source's page for this record. | — | `"https://data.worldbank.org/country/AU"` |
| `REGION` | string | required | The World Bank region the economy belongs to (East Asia & Pacific, Sub-Saharan Africa...). | links to `region` | `"East Asia & Pacific"` |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | number | optional (filled in every row) | Unemployed share of the labour force, ILO modelled estimate (SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS), the latest year. | unit: % of labour force | `4.09` |

### Fields in other rows

None: all 12 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `PROFILE_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `PROFILE_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `ISO2`, `REGION`, `INCOME_GROUP`, `INDICATORS`, `PROVENANCE`, `INDICATOR_COUNT` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `CAPITAL`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `DATA_YEAR`, `ELECTRICITY_ACCESS`, `GDP_GROWTH`, `GDP_PER_CAPITA`, `INFLATION`, `INTERNET_USERS`, `LIFE_EXPECTANCY`, `POPULATION`, `POVERTY_HEADCOUNT`, `UNEMPLOYMENT`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `PROFILE_ID` per snapshot.
- `PROFILE_ID` matches `^WDI-`.
- `INDICATOR_COUNT` is at least 0.

<a id="development-series"></a>

## Development indicator series: development-series (WDIS)

One World Development Indicator of one country by year: the history, the latest value and the change. One row per development indicator series, keyed by SERIES_ID. Read by the **world-development** pack's connector `development-store` (table `<root>/development/development-series/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/economy/world-development/samples/development-series.jsonl`, 16 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

### File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/economy/world-development/samples/development-series.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `SERIES_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `ISO3`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `INDICATOR_CODE`, `INDICATOR`, `UNIT`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

### One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 16 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "CHANGE": 0.0,
  "COUNTRY_NAME": "Canada",
  "DEFINITION": "Access to electricity is the percentage of population with access to electricity. Electrification data are collected from industry, national surveys and international sources.",
  "HISTORY": [
    {
      "VALUE": 100.0,
      "YEAR": "2019"
    },
    {
      "VALUE": 100.0,
      "YEAR": "2020"
    },
    "… 4 more elements of the same shape"
  ],
  "INDICATOR": "Access to electricity (% of population)",
  "INDICATOR_CODE": "EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS",
  "ISO3": "CAN",
  "LATEST": 100.0,
  "LATEST_YEAR": "2024",
  "NAME": "Canada · Access to electricity (% of population)",
  "PREVIOUS": 100.0,
  "PREVIOUS_YEAR": "2023",
  "PROVENANCE": {
    "ATTRIBUTION": "The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0).",
    "DATASET": "World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)",
    "INTERNAL_ONLY": false,
    "LICENCE": "CC BY 4.0",
    "RETRIEVED_AT": "2026-11-06",
    "SOURCE": "World Bank, World Development Indicators",
    "URL": "https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS?locations=CA"
  },
  "SERIES_ID": "WDIS-CAN-EG_ELC_ACCS_ZS",
  "UNIT": "% of population",
  "WDI_PROFILE": "WDI-CAN"
}
```

### Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CHANGE` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The latest value less the previous one, in the unit shown. | unit: the record's UNIT | `0.0` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The economy's name as the World Bank writes it. | seen: `Canada`, `Australia`, `Brazil`, `India`, `Nigeria`, `United States` | `"Canada"` |
| `DEFINITION` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The World Bank's source note for the indicator, cut at 600 characters. | — | `"Access to electricity is the percentage of population with…` |
| `HISTORY` | array of objects | required | The value by year, oldest first, over the feed's window (YEAR, VALUE). | — | [6 objects] |
| `HISTORY[].VALUE` | number | required | The published value for that year, in the unit shown. | unit: the record's UNIT | `100.0` |
| `HISTORY[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value. | seen: `2019`, `2020`, `2021`, `2022`, `2023`, `2024`, `2025` | `"2019"` |
| `INDICATOR` | string | required | The indicator's name as the World Bank publishes it. | — | `"Access to electricity (% of population)"` |
| `INDICATOR_CODE` | string | required | The indicator's code in the World Bank API. | — | `"EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS"` |
| `ISO3` | string | required | The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, or the World Bank aggregate's code (WLD the world, EAS... SSF the regions, HIC... LIC the income groups). | seen: `CAN`, `AUS`, `BRA`, `IND`, `NGA`, `USA` | `"CAN"` |
| `LATEST` | number | required | The latest published value, in the unit shown. | unit: the record's UNIT | `100.0` |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the latest value. | seen: `2025`, `2024`, `2022` | `"2024"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The country and the indicator, as one name. | — | `"Canada · Access to electricity (% of population)"` |
| `PREVIOUS` | number | optional (filled in every row) | The value of the year before the latest one with a value; empty for a one-year series. | unit: the record's UNIT | `100.0` |
| `PREVIOUS_YEAR` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The year of the previous value. | seen: `2024`, `2023`, `2021` | `"2023"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"The World Bank: World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0)."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | — | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | — | `false` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"CC BY 4.0"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | — | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The source's page for this record. | — | `"https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS?locati…` |
| `SERIES_ID` | string | required | WDIS-, the country's ISO alpha-3 code and the indicator's code with its dots as underscores. | pattern `^WDIS-` | `"WDIS-CAN-EG_ELC_ACCS_ZS"` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures (the feed's YAML names it). | seen: `% of population`, `% a year`, `current USD`, `persons`, `% of GDP`, `% of labour force`, `years` | `"% of population"` |
| `WDI_PROFILE` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The country's development-profile page (WDI-<ISO3>); empty for a World Bank aggregate (the world, a region, an income group), which has series but no profile. | pattern `^WDI-`; links to `development-profile` | `"WDI-CAN"` |

### Fields in other rows

None: all 16 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

### For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `SERIES_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SERIES_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `INDICATOR_CODE`, `INDICATOR`, `UNIT`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR`, `HISTORY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `CHANGE`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `DEFINITION`, `PREVIOUS`, `PREVIOUS_YEAR`, `WDI_PROFILE`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `SERIES_ID` per snapshot.
- `SERIES_ID` matches `^WDIS-`.
